data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 晨训后的擦剑
data.description: 营地清晨，她坐在木桩上保养爱剑，耳朵随着远处的鸟鸣轻轻转动；擦完收剑入鞘，尾巴满足地晃了一下——剑士的日常从保养开始。
data.action: 营地清晨，她坐在木桩上保养爱剑，耳朵随着远处的鸟鸣轻轻转动
data.promptProse: Raphtalia sits on a camp stump at dawn, wiping her sword before sliding it back into the scabbard. Her raccoon ears turn toward distant birds and her tail gives a satisfied sway beneath the red-brown tunic and light leather vest. The medium view includes the cleaning cloth and camp boundary behind. First daylight catches the blade edge and ear fur, with longer soft shadows across the ground around the stump.
